notes: The second isnad («وقال محمد حدثنا أبو عامر العقدي») follows the saying and carries it again with wording changes: a second group
«وقال محمد» names a bare «محمد» as transmitter; the text writes him as a transmitter, so he is read as narrator (rule 13). It could be the compiler's own name; left as written
«إسماعيل» in the first isnad and «إسماعيل بن أبي خالد» in the second are kept as written
